title: 第5章 突然的耳光第6章 辍学
lines: 李骏读书的烦恼，谁都没办法破解。
他就不是这块料，徐花还专门托人从西平城的庙里请来符水，让李骏喝。
李骏看着那脏兮兮的符水，在李三的怒视下，只能捏着鼻子喝了。
但读书，还是不得劲，没少挨纪夫子呵斥。
李骏天性活泼，机灵聪慧，但这些教人的经书，真的是让他厌恶。
过一段时日，荷叶塘的宁静再次被打破。
一个青年快马从外城赶到了荷叶塘。
马儿的奔蹄声，引得路边的老农们回头瞻望。
那青年在书荷学堂门口落了马，急冲冲的往里面走去，一边还叫着，纪夫子，纪夫子。
随后，约莫半盏茶的功夫，纪夫子带上了行李包袱，匆匆离去。
第二日，村长赵标就来告知乡邻，昨日纪夫子老家，家中有丧，随人回城去了，于是学堂忽然没了老师。
好在，纪夫子走的时候，留下一封信给赵标，他说可以委托西平城里的万卷私塾，帮忙请一个先生暂替。
纪夫子说守丧也要三年时长，再回来也不知是何时了，也许不再回来。
众人听罢，也只好让人去西平城里的万卷私塾去问问。
半个月后，荷叶塘迎来了一位新夫子的面孔——丁阙浅。
这位年轻的教书先生，带着一家老小，浩浩荡荡地来到这个宁静的小村落，不像是来应聘的，更像是来搬家落户的。
丁阙浅的到来，引起了村民们的好奇，毕竟，这可是要接替声名远扬的纪夫子，成为新一任教书先生的人物。
丁阙浅自称是万卷私塾的“预备先生”
，听起来挺高大上的。
唯一的问题是——除了读过几本书，有个垫底的功名撑着门面，没有任何教学经验。
面对那些天真无邪、活泼好动的乡村孩子，丁阙浅显得格外局促不安，仿佛一个误入羊群的狼，不知道从哪下嘴。
“肃静！
给我静下来！”
这是丁阙浅最常挂在嘴边的话。
然而，学堂内里一片鸡飞狗跳，小男孩们叽叽喳喳，似乎丝毫不受他的威严影响。
有时候，丁阙浅甚至觉得，自己仿佛是个掉入了“孩子地狱”
的判官，每天要对这些“小恶魔”
们绞尽脑汁。
“山里人就是山里人，真是聒噪，来这里教书，我真是拯救他们！”
丁阙浅常常在心里嘀咕。
然而，作为一位立志要当“严师出高徒”
的先生，他绝不能让这些“小鬼”
爬到他头上。
于是，才没过几天，他决定采取“严厉教育”
的策略——呵斥、打骂、惩罚一样不缺。
content_en:
No one can solve Li Jun's troubles in studying.
He was not that good. Xu Hua even asked someone to bring Fu Shui from the temple in Xiping City for Li Jun to drink.
Li Jun looked at the dirty talisman water, and under Li San's glare, he could only hold his nose and drink it.
However, I still had trouble studying, and I was often scolded by Master Ji.
Li Jun is lively, clever and intelligent by nature, but these teaching scriptures really disgust him.
After a while, the tranquility of the lotus leaf pond was broken again.
A young man rushed from the outer city to the lotus leaf pond.
The sound of galloping hooves attracted the old farmers on the roadside to look back.
The young man got off his horse at the door of Shuhe Academy and hurriedly walked inside, shouting, Master Ji, Master Ji.
Then, after about half a cup of tea, Ji Fuzi took his luggage and left in a hurry.
The next day, the village chief Zhao Biao came to tell the neighbors that there was a funeral in Ji Fuzi's hometown yesterday, and he went back to the city with others, so the school suddenly lost its teacher.
Fortunately, when Master Ji left, he left a letter to Zhao Biao. He said that he could entrust Wanjuan Private School in Xiping City to hire a teacher to temporarily replace him.
Master Ji said that the mourning would last for three years, and he didn't know when he would come back, and he might never come back again.
After everyone heard this, they had no choice but to ask people to go to Wanjuan Private School in Xiping City.
Half a month later, the lotus leaf pond welcomed the face of a new wife - Ding Queqian.
This young teacher came to this quiet little village with his whole family. He didn't look like he was applying for a job, but more like he was here to move and settle down.
The arrival of Ding Queqian aroused the curiosity of the villagers. After all, this is the person who will succeed the famous Master Ji and become the new teacher.
Ding Queqian claims to be the "preparatory teacher" of Wanjuan Private School
, it sounds quite noble.
The only problem is - except for having read a few books and having a low-level reputation to support my appearance, I have no teaching experience.
Facing those innocent, lively and active country children, Ding Queqian seemed particularly embarrassed and uneasy, like a wolf that strayed into the flock of sheep and didn't know where to start his mouth.
"Quiet!
Calm down! "
This is what Ding Queqian often talks about.
However, there was a lot of chatter in the school, and the little boys were chattering, seemingly unaffected by his majesty.
Sometimes, Ding Queqian even feels as if he has fallen into "child hell"
The judge has to deal with these "little devils" every day
They racked their brains.
"People from the mountains are people from the mountains. It's really noisy. Come here to teach, I really save them!"
Ding Queqian often muttered in his heart.
However, as a person who is determined to be a "strict teacher makes a good disciple"
Sir, he will never let these "little devils"
Climb on top of him.
So, within a few days, he decided to take "severe education"
There is no shortage of strategies - scolding, beating and punishment.
